## A tool and its maker

```{dot}
digraph {
  layout=neato; splines=ortho;
  node [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fillcolor=white];
  data [label="Data", pos="0,0!"];
  tool [label=<<TABLE BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="4"><TR><TD WIDTH="28" HEIGHT="28" FIXEDSIZE="TRUE"></TD><TD>Tool</TD></TR></TABLE>>, image="face.png", pos="2.5,0!"];
  data -> tool;
}
```
